description: The logic of the Review tab that is not the hunk model: the marks a person makes on hunks (ui/src/lib/review-accepted.ts), what may be offered for a file and when, the keys, the errors of the Hub, the plans of "accept all" and "reject all" (review-rules.ts), what the tab does with a file against a source of review (review-actions.ts), the source of a conversation's checkpoints (review-source-task.ts) and the way in from a turn and from a receipt (review-offer.ts), judged by ui/tests/review-accepted.test.mjs, review-rules.test.mjs, review-actions.test.mjs, review-source-task.test.mjs and review-offer.test.mjs. tests/ui-review-state-for-mutation.mjs runs them in the copy of the Hub that the runner makes; the copy has no node_modules, so it borrows the diff package from the folder the copy was made from. The components are not mutated: their tests bundle them with esbuild, which needs the whole of node_modules.
